text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Good morning! The flowers you had on
display were wilted, so I
replaced them
with new ones!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and that there on your desk is a lucky
handkerchief my dad
makes. It's good feng
shui and made of really soft material, so
you
should have it! What else...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The windows are closed, so open them up!
Air circulation is the basis
of feng shui, you
know? And now your day's set to be super
lucky! ☆
Well, see you at training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to her adjustments to the office, I
start to find myself in a
good mood more
often, and my work is going swimmingly.
But I can't
help thinking...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As her trainer, it's supposed to be my job
to support her. I wonder
what I can do to
repay her...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, it's you, Trainer! What a
coincidence! ...Right, do you have
some
time now? There's somewhere I'd like to
show you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's sudden, but I'm not actually in a rush,
so I go with her.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So here we are, the zoo! Hehe, outings like
this are great for getting
your qi flowing,
so it might just bring you some luck!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The key is to go in your auspicious
direction! And this zoo just so
happens to
be in that direction, so I've been meaning
to bring you
here for a... while...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Is someone crying? Sorry, I have to check
if something happened!

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: Where did... everyone go? Sniffle...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay? What are you doing out
here all alone?

text_block_list.name: Timid Girl
text_block_list.text: I... I... Waaah! I dunno where they went!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Okay, so she got separated from her
family... Figures, with the
landform around
here being this damp and all.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
For now, let me take you to the lost kids
center! It's a nice place filled
with fun
things to do!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment Copano Rickey grabs the
girl's hand...
Oh, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I shouldn't have let go of your
hand! Mom and Dad are
looking for you,
so let's hurry back!
Um... thank you!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No problem, I just stayed with her, that's
all. I'm glad you found each
other! Take
care!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah! On your way back, go down the
big path in the middle! It's
the most
auspicious path, so it's also the safest!

text_block_list.name: Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Auspicious path? Um... are you into, like...
occult stuff?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, it's nothing to do with the occult, but I
suppose it does often get
mistaken for it.
Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Well, at school, they told us not to go with
people who say suspicious
things, because
you could get kidnapped! So... Oh!

text_block_list.name: Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
D-didn't you just say you would take my
sister somewhere nice?!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that? What I meant is, the landform
around here is making the qi
stagnant.
Doesn't the humidity make you feel a bit
sluggish?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
That means you have to be careful of the
stagnant qi on the borders
of the eight
trigrams, so I thought she should be
somewhere more
lucky...

text_block_list.name: Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
Stagnant qi? Trigrams? I don't know those
words. Oh, you must be...
Mooommyyy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I calm down the children and explain that
Copano Rickey is a student
at the
academy who wanted to take the girl to
the lost kids center.
She's not anyone
suspicious.

text_block_list.name: Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
S-s-s-sorry! I'm sorry! I was just so scared,
and I... I... Forgive me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It worked out in the end, but I'm worried
that the incident just now
put a damper on
her mood...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I messed that up! Thank you for
working things out! I guess
feng shui must
sound kind of scary to children.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I probably should have waited for the little
girl to calm down before I
started
explaining things. People always tell me
that I come on too
strong. Well, lesson
learned!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe she's fine? She's talking
normally, and she's already
reflected on
what went wrong and how to fix it. But the
tension
showing on her face tells a
different story.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What? Yep, never better! I'll take care not
to make the same mistake
again, and I
definitely won't let it get to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey is good at lifting the mood
with feng shui. Her ability
to avoid
disturbing her qi by planning for the future
and working
toward those plans is her
strength.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That's why she's desperately attempting to
put a lid on her negative
emotions right
now and ignore them altogether. I tell her
that I've
noticed.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Yeah. Maybe you're right. You know,
my dad told me something
similar once.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
He said I try too hard to solve everything
with feng shui, and I tend to
avoid facing
my feelings... especially when I feel weak.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Feng shui works subconsciously, so you
shouldn't put a lid on it. I
thought I knew
that, but... heh, looks like I messed up
again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So, um... what now? How am I supposed to
solve my problems without
feng shui?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She puzzles over the question. My guess is
that she needs to start by
simply
acknowledging her emotions.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Huh? How'd I feel? Well, let's see... When
the girl screamed, I felt a
tightness in my
chest and my mind went blank...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Sad? Oh, I think that's it! But I get
misunderstood all the time, so that
part
wasn't a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It's just... I know I can do better than that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah! I don't usually make people
scream! I know I can tell people
how to
improve their luck more effectively!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...So, yeah. That's what I was thinking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
When she looks at me, I notice her face
has relaxed and she's got her
usual
cheerful expression back.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whew, I'm feeling better already! It's like a
weight's been lifted off
my chest! ...Guess I
really was ignoring my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the talk. ...You're the best,
Trainer!
